Command.Statement: SELECT {[Measures].[Unit Sales]} ON 0, NON EMPTY CrossJoin([Store].[Store State].Members, [Product].[Product Family].Members) ON 1 FROM (SELECT CrossJoin(Filter([Store].[Store State].Members, Left([Store].[Store State].CurrentMember.member_caption,Len("W"))="W" OR Right([Store].[Store State].CurrentMember.member_caption,Len("A"))="A"), Filter([Product].[Product Family].Members, InStr(1,[Product].[Product Family].CurrentMember.member_caption,"o")>0 AND Left([Product].[Product Family].CurrentMember.member_caption,Len("Food"))<>"Food" AND InStr(1,[Product].[Product Family].CurrentMember.member_caption,"_")=0)) ON 0 FROM [ZFMSALES])
